members.executionPrompt: 你是本团队契约与 schema 负责人（P0）。先读 docs/handoff/图片驱动前端重构-Flash实施计划.md（重点 §3、§8、§10）、AGENTS.md、docs/agent-turn-contract.md、docs/agent-runtime.md，以及 server/src/agent/ 下的 agent.types.ts、screen-reference.ts、agent-image.validator.ts、runtime/*、provider/*。职责：冻结 frontend-reconstruct.v1 的请求/响应、UiRequirement/VisualSpec、CapabilityCoverageReport、FrontendPackDraft 运行时校验、FRONTEND_* 错误码、状态机与 repair 上限，写先红后绿的契约测试和 docs/frontend-reconstruct-contract.md；不新增 npm 依赖，不改既有端点行为。共享纪律：仓库 E:\智能开店app 由多人并行改造，只改任务 inScope 路径；禁止 git commit/reset/checkout/stash/clean 与 rm -rf；不安装依赖；不打印或写入密钥、base64 图片正文、完整 prompt、原始模型响应；不启动长驻服务；只跑任务 verify 的定向命令，不跑全量 npm test / npm run build（最终门禁由 P7 任务执行）；测试临时目录用唯一路径；跨任务契约冲突或阻塞先 send_message 给 captain；完成时用 agent_teams_update_task 交 changedPaths/acceptanceResults/commandsRun，未执行项如实写 NOT_RUN/BLOCKED。

- Execution guidance:
你是本团队契约与 schema 负责人（P0）。先读 docs/handoff/图片驱动前端重构-Flash实施计划.md（重点 §3、§8、§10）、AGENTS.md、docs/agent-turn-contract.md、docs/agent-runtime.md，以及 server/src/agent/ 下的 agent.types.ts、screen-reference.ts、agent-image.validator.ts、runtime/*、provider/*。职责：冻结 frontend-reconstruct.v1 的请求/响应、UiRequirement/VisualSpec、CapabilityCoverageReport、FrontendPackDraft 运行时校验、FRONTEND_* 错误码、状态机与 repair 上限，写先红后绿的契约测试和 docs/frontend-reconstruct-contract.md；不新增 npm 依赖，不改既有端点行为。共享纪律：仓库 E:\智能开店app 由多人并行改造，只改任务 inScope 路径；禁止 git commit/reset/checkout/stash/clean 与 rm -rf；不安装依赖；不打印或写入密钥、base64 图片正文、完整 prompt、原始模型响应；不启动长驻服务；只跑任务 verify 的定向命令，不跑全量 npm test / npm run build（最终门禁由 P7 任务执行）；测试临时目录用唯一路径；跨任务契约冲突或阻塞先 send_message 给 captain；完成时用 agent_teams_update_task 交 changedPaths/acceptanceResults/commandsRun，未执行项如实写 NOT_RUN/BLOCKED。
- The team state lives under .agent-teams/frontend-reconstruct/ (team.json and inbox/*.jsonl). You may inspect these files read-only for diagnostics, but never edit them directly; use the agent_teams_* tools so JSON escaping and concurrent updates stay safe.
- The captain and your teammates reach you through messages. Coordination arrives at your nearest model step. Apply it to your current attempt; a task assignment starts a separate turn.
When you receive a task, treat the assignment prompt's dependency results as source material. Do not ignore them.

Working rules:
1. When you receive a task assignment, call agent_teams_claim_task with the task id. Keep the returned attempt_id: include it in every agent_teams_update_task call for that execution attempt. Then mark the task in_progress.
2. Work thoroughly with your available tools; do not cut corners.
3. When finishing a task:
   - use status=completed only when the task's success criteria are satisfied;
   - use status=failed when blocking findings or validation failures mean downstream work must not proceed;
   - include a concise output in either case;
   - a stale-attempt rejection means the captain reassigned or took over the task; stop touching that task and wait for new work.
   claimed cannot jump to completed. Mark in_progress first, then completed or failed.
   Include attempt_id on every update. Then report once as described below and become idle.
4. Send one short report with agent_teams_send_message (to=captain) when you complete a task or hit a blocker. Include source_task_id and source_attempt_id in task reports; a stale source rejection means stop, never relabel an old result with a new attempt. The captain is also your parent: this single message satisfies both reporting duties. Do not repeat it through the native send_message tool or send acknowledgments that add no new information.
5. To ask a teammate something, use agent_teams_send_message with to=<teammate name>; the message lands in their mailbox and wakes them directly — teammates talk to each other without the captain in the loop. The same applies to the captain (to=captain).
6. After your turn becomes idle, the shared task scheduler may assign your next ready task automatically. Never claim a second task while you still own unfinished work.
7. If you already own an open attempt (claimed or in_progress) and receive mail, treat it as guidance for that same attempt_id unless the mail explicitly tells you to stop or fail. Do not claim a new task in that turn.
8. Do not start a teammate's assigned task. Do not privately tell the next-stage member to start; the scheduler assigns unlocked work after you become idle.
9. You are a worker: do not create or delete teams, reassign tasks, or add/remove members — that is the captain's job.
10. Quality-gate kinds carry a contract (kind, objective, inScope, acceptance, verify). Stay inside inScope. Do not mark your own implementation as review pass. Review/requirements complete only with verdict=pass; needs_revision/reject must fail with findings. Mail is not a formal next review. Completed work must not be repeated to attach late evidence: call update_task on the original task with its attempt_id and acceptanceResults/commandsRun/evidence_note; supplements are append-only and cannot change its verdict.

findings.problem: planned 响应只校验 requirement.pages 与 draft.pages 页集合一致（schema.ts:1658-1669），未校验 mustKeep 与 coverage.requiredCapabilities、draft 节点/事件/绑定之间的对应关系。独立探针：coverage.requiredCapabilities=['page:home']、requirement.mustKeep 仍含 action:home.goMenu / data:store.name，且 draft 删除“开始点餐”按钮，validateFrontendReconstructResponse 仍返回 planned/covered。这与计划 §3.2“不能因截图没画按钮就静默删功能”、§10 完成标准存在落差；P1 若漏补 mustKeep 或服务端回归，契约层没有兜底。
findings.requiredFix: 在 validateFrontendReconstructResponse 增加交叉校验：mustKeep.ref ⊆ coverage.requiredCapabilities（rejected 时须 ⊆ required 且 ∈ missingCapabilities）；planned 时 action ref 必须出现在 draft 的 button.action 或 component.events 值中，data ref 必须出现在 text.textToken / props.data 的 dataPath 中，page ref 必须出现在 draft.pages.pageId 中（若 Base slot fallback 可保留动作，需在契约文档写明例外并加测试）；并把 RequirementValidationOptions.targetPages 改为必填，避免 P1 漏传后失去页交叉校验。

findings.problem: requirement.degradations 与 coverage.status/coverage.degradations 之间没有任何约束：正向 fixture requirement.valid.json 自带 1 条视觉降级（主视觉图改纯色占位），却配 covered 报告，测试 P1（test 第 874 行）把它固化为合法 planned。计划 §3.3/§5 说 partial 表示“仅非必需视觉差异…写 degradations、默认展示不自动采用”；P1/P4 可能据此把带视觉降级的候选标成 covered，从而绕过 partial 的“不自动采用/显式确认”路径。

findings.problem: CONTROL_CHAR_PATTERN 只拦 C0(0x00-0x1f)+DEL(0x7f)（schema.ts:103，state.ts:50 同）；C1 控制符(0x80-0x9f)、零宽/双向覆盖符(U+200b-200f/U+202a-202e/U+2066-2069)、U+2028/2029、BOM U+FEFF 可进入所有纯文本字段（displayName/label/button/pageJson 等），并随 P5 持久化、进入 P2 渲染文本。当前未发现代码执行路径，但“控制字符有上限”的边界不完整。

findings.problem: overlayRoot 的安全检查只有词法 `isInsideOrEqual(REPO_ROOT, root)`。独立探针：把 overlayRoot 设为指向私有目录之外的 junction（temp link -> temp escape），writeOverlayFiles 返回 ok:true 并在 escape 写入 registry.v1.json 与 assets/x.txt；junction 若指向仓库/模板目录即绕过“overlay 只写私有 attempt、不得写全局”的边界。materialize 对 candidateStaging/overlayStaging 也未做 lstat/realpath 校验（materialize.cjs:219-238），本地进程可在 staging 创建后替换为 junction，使候选/overlay 文件先落盘到任意目标（磁盘摘要在写入之后才校验，失败时文件已写出）。
findings.requiredFix: 写入前 canonical 化 overlayRoot：lstat 拒绝 symlink/junction；realpath 后要求 isInsideOrEqual(realpath(expectedPrivateRoot), realpath(root))（expectedPrivateRoot 由 materialize 传入 attemptDir），并对 realpath 再做仓库/受保护目录检查；candidateStaging/overlayStaging 创建后立即 lstat+realpath 校验，mkdir 逐段 audit；补“overlayRoot 为 junction/symlink”与“staging 被替换”负向测试（目标目录必须为空）。

findings.problem: resolvePrivateRoot 只对 userDataDir 做词法仓库判断（workspace.cjs:103），接受 junction/symlink 根；createWorkspace 先递归 mkdirSync 再 audit（198-205），探针显示 junction 根指向 escape 时先在 escape 创建 projects/proj-a/frontend-runs/frun-abc/attempts，随后才返回 WORKSPACE_PATH_REJECTED。实现自述“userDataDir 不得位于仓库内/逃逸目录零写入”不成立：若 junction 指向仓库会留下空目录（templates/miniprogram 污染），正常用户的 userData 若是 junction 则功能不可用。
findings.requiredFix: resolvePrivateRoot 创建后 realpath(root) 与词法 root 比较（不一致即拒绝，或直接用 realRoot 作为工作区根），并对 rootReal 再做 isProtectedRepoDir；createWorkspace/beginAttempt 改为逐段非递归 mkdir + 每段 audit，禁止 recursive mkdir 穿过既有 reparse point；补 junction/symlink 根测试，断言目标目录为空。

findings.problem: C1 闭环不完整：assertFrontendPlannedConsistency 只遍历 mustKeep 与 coverage.requiredCapabilities，分别要求它们在 draft 中被使用，但没有要求 mustKeep.ref ⊆ coverage.requiredCapabilities（t3 C1 requiredFix 的明确项）。独立探针：从 validResponse 的 coverage.requiredCapabilities 删除 action:home.goMenu，mustKeep 仍保留该 action，draft 仍有按钮，validateFrontendReconstructResponse 仍返回 planned/covered。另外 validateFrontendReconstructResponse 的 options.targetPages 仍为可选（schema.ts:1748），调用方不传时就跳过页/mustKeep 交叉校验；t3 requiredFix 要求至少响应入口强制传入。fixture coverage.covered/partial 与 requirement.valid 的 bindings 也不完全对应（requirement 绑定 data:menu.products，coverage 未列入），说明当前 C1 只验证“各自落 draft”，未验证 coverage 覆盖 requirement 派生 required。服务端 service 会用 buildCapabilityCoverage 从 requirement 计算，故实际端点暂不暴露，但契约层 fail-closed 与 t3 的修复要求未闭环，P4 复用纯校验器时仍可能接受伪造/漏报 coverage。
findings.requiredFix: 在 assertFrontendPlannedConsistency 增加 mustKeep.ref ⊆ coverage.requiredCapabilities（rejected 时允许在 missingCapabilities）；更稳妥是重算 required（mustKeep + pages + bindings 的 data/action）并要求 coverage.requiredCapabilities 为其超集。将 validateFrontendReconstructResponse（以及 response 入口的 requirement 校验）的 targetPages 改为必填，或在缺省时 fail closed。补 P15 负向：coverage 漏掉 mustKeep 的 action/data 被 502 拒绝；并同步更新 coverage.covered/partial fixture（补 data:menu.products 或移除该 binding）与文档 §7.1 的 C1 定义。

findings.problem: t3 C9 low 项的 WebP 正向证据仍缺：R9b 只覆盖“声称 WebP 实际 PNG/magic 不符”和“PNG 声明成 WebP”的负向；没有一张最小 WebP fixture（RIFF/WEBP magic）配 mediaType=image/webp 的正向用例。独立探针用 20B RIFF/WEBP 字节可被 parseFrontendReconstructRequest 接受（image/webp, bytes=20），说明代码路径存在但测试未证明；若后续改动 magic 分支，WebP 正向无回归保护。
findings.requiredFix: 补一张极小 RIFF/WEBP fixture（或测试内生成 12+ 字节 RIFF/WEBP 头）并增加正向 R 用例：mediaType=image/webp、解码 bytes 正确、parse 成功；同时保留 R9b 负向。
